stem: Which line from the play suggests that Scott disagrees with Amy’s opinion of Bella?

options.label: A
options.text: SCOTT: Remember what I told you?

options.label: B
options.text: SCOTT: From what I can see, “shun” words aren’t easy for you.

options.label: C
options.text: SCOTT: Besides, you’re really good at lots of other stuff.

options.label: D
options.text: SCOTT: You should just keep on rapping.
